name: Fruit Punch Tarantula | 1g
description:
Our essential tarantula joint. One gram of flower, infused with flavor and coated in kief. Heavy hitting, flavor-filled cannabis products to bring that Cali-vibe to your blazing sesh!

The Fruit Punch flavor is a vibrant burst of fruity goodness, making each puff a refreshing delight. As a hybrid strain, this preroll combines the best of both Sativa and Indica worlds, offering a balanced experience that can vary from uplifting and energizing to relaxing and calming, depending on your mood and setting. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or spark creativity, this hybrid preroll has got you covered.
